text: {"subject":"Claim C019794 past payer filing limit, write-off decision needed","body":"Hello billing lead, claim C019794 for patient PT0232 (date of service 2026-11-06, service code T1019, 28 units, billed $170.80) was submitted 2027-01-23, 78 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, so the claim is predicted to deny with reason D03. Editing the claim cannot fix this. It needs a write-off decision rather than correction and resubmission. Could you review it and let me know the write-off decision as soon as possible, since the claim is already past the filing limit and further delay will not help recovery."}
